speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Master Florio? William Shakespeare, from Bishopsgate. I'd ask you of a town.

speaker: john_florio
text: Verona? I'll tell you Verona. But you'll put a sea-coast on it, I know you poets.

speaker: john_florio
text: A river bent round the city like an arm. An old Roman playing-place of stone, bigger than any in London.

speaker: john_florio
text: The lords of the place are buried not in a church but beside one, in the open street, in tombs like stone tents.

speaker: john_florio
text: Mantua is a day's ride off. In the heat the young men walk abroad with swords. There is nothing else to do with a July afternoon.

speaker: john_florio
text: Amor, tosse e fumo malamente si nascondono. Love, a cough and smoke are ill hidden.

speaker: john_florio
text: With the court. That is all I am giving you of him.
